name: Shikitari
description: The Shikitari were a rare, dim-witted insectoid species native to the planet Shikitari in the Unknown Regions. They possessed a multi-stage life cycle, and during the final years of the Old Republic, very few individuals were aware of the Shikitari, with fewer still considered experts on their unique physiology.

data.name: Shikitari
data.lifespan: Multi-stage; the pupae form lasting only two standard days
